# Voyages Impressionnistes

> > Discover Impressionist heritage through guided tours, cycling routes, painting workshops, and cultural experiences across Seine Valley, Normandy, Paris, and historic artist villages.

Voyages Impressionnistes celebrates 150 years of Impressionism by offering immersive cultural tourism experiences in the footsteps of Monet, Pissarro, and other masters. The site guides visitors through iconic locations like Giverny, Auvers-sur-Oise, Rouen, Honfleur, and the Seine estuary with exhibitions, plein air painting classes, bike tours, and heritage walks.

## Key Topics

- Impressionism 150th anniversary
- Seine Valley cycling routes
- Monet and Impressionist painters
- Normandie Impressionniste Festival
- Plein air painting workshops
- Giverny and Auvers-sur-Oise
- Rouen Cathedral and Seine meanders
- Seine estuary (Honfleur, Le Havre, Deauville)
- Paris Montmartre Impressionist history
- Cultural heritage walks
- Museum exhibitions and collections
- La Ferme Saint-Siméon
- Alabaster Coast (Côte d'Albâtre)
- Impressionist tourism experiences
- Barbizon and Oise Valley

## Immersive Experiences & Workshops

- [Painting at la Ferme Saint Siméon](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/en/seine-estuary/outdoor-painting-class-at-la-ferme-saint-simeon): Plein air painting class at la Ferme Saint Siméon in Honfleur
- [Tonight with the Impressionists - VR](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/en/paris-montmartre/tonight-with-the-impressionists-paris-1874): VR experience at Musée d'Orsay recreating Paris 1874 Impressionist scene
- [Monet et la côte d'Albâtre](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/cote-albatre/peindre-comme-monet-sur-la-cote-d-albatre): Paint like Monet experience on Alabaster Coast at Fécamp
- [Atelier peinture avec François Buhot](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/barbizon-yerres/atelier-peinture-avec-francois-buhot): Painting workshop with artist François Buhot for Impressionism 150 years

## Cycling Tours & Cultural Walks

- [La Seine à vélo Estuaire Seine](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/estuaire-seine/la-seine-a-velo-estuaire-seine): Seine cycling routes through estuary from Honfleur to Deauville and Le Havre
- [Visite à vélo L'Isle-Adam](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/en/auvers-oise-valley/visite-impressionniste-a-velo-l-isle-adam): Impressionist bike tour in L'Isle-Adam for 150th anniversary celebration
- [Visite à vélo L'Isle-Adam](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/auvers-vallee-oise/visite-impressionniste-a-velo-l-isle-adam): Impressionist bike tour in L'Isle-Adam celebrating 150 years
- [Visite guidée à vélo Daubigny à Auvers](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/en/auvers-oise-valley/visite-guidee-a-velo-avec-visite-de-la-maison-atelier-daubigny): Guided bike tour with Daubigny workshop visit in Auvers-sur-Oise
- [Randonnée culturelle Port-Marly](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/les-bords-de-seine/randonnee-culturelle-du-port-marly-au-pecq): Cultural hiking tour from Port-Marly to Le Pecq for Impressionism 150 years
- [Journée impressionniste au Pecq](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/les-bords-de-seine/journee-impressionniste-au-pecq): Full day Impressionist experience in Le Pecq on Seine riverbanks

## Major Exhibitions & Museums

- [Première exposition impressionniste](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/paris-montmartre/premiere-exposition-impressionniste): History of the first Impressionist exhibition for 150th anniversary
- [Cathédrale de lumière 2022](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/rouen-les-boucles-de-la-seine/cathedrale-de-lumiere-2022): Immersive light show at Rouen Cathedral celebrating Monet's series
- [Pissarro sur le chemin de Pontoise](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/auvers-vallee-oise/pissarro-sur-le-chemin-de-pontoise): Pissarro exhibition at Pontoise museum for Automne Impressionniste 2024
- [Voiles exposition aux Franciscaines](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/estuaire-seine/voiles-du-temps-calme-a-la-tempete-exposition): Voiles exhibition at Les Franciscaines Deauville featuring Impressionist art
- [Le legs Baudoux au MBA de Rouen](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/rouen-les-boucles-de-la-seine/beaux-arts-rouen-legs-baudoux): Baudoux legacy enriches Rouen Fine Arts Museum Impressionist collection
- [Photographier en Normandie](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/estuaire-seine/photographier-en-normandie): Photography and Impressionism exhibition at MuMa Le Havre
- [Frank Boggs. En marge de l'impressionnisme](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/les-bords-de-seine/frank-boggs-en-marge-de-limpressionnisme): American painter Frank Boggs exhibition at Meudon Art and History Museum

## Guided Tours & Regional Discoveries

- [Visites guidées Le Havre](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/en/seine-estuary/visites-guidees-le-havre-sous-les-pinceaux-des-peintres): Guided tours of Le Havre painters' sites for Normandie Impressionniste
- [Venise une question de point de vue](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/en/rouen-the-seine-meanders/venise-une-question-de-point-de-vue): Venice point of view exhibition at Louviers museum for Normandie Festival
- [Olga Kisseleva, La Zone](https://voyagesimpressionnistes.com/giverny-ses-environs/la-zone-olga-kisseleva): Olga Kisseleva's La Zone exhibition at Évreux Museum for Normandie Festival
